title: E-Commerce Sales Analytics Pipeline
summary: An end-to-end ETL pipeline that ingests, cleans and loads large-scale e-commerce sales data into Snowflake, with Power BI on top and Gemini checking the output.
highlights: Engineered an end-to-end ETL pipeline ingesting, cleaning, transforming and loading large-scale e-commerce sales data into Snowflake, cutting processing time ~40%.
Built automated data-validation and exception-handling workflows, with Power BI dashboards tracking revenue, customer segmentation and sales KPIs.
Integrated Gemini to automate data-quality checks and schema validation on ETL outputs, and used prompt engineering to auto-generate SQL queries and technical documentation.

title: Smart Attendance Management System
summary: Facial-recognition attendance that identifies people from a photo and handles tracking and reporting on its own.
highlights: Built a facial-recognition attendance system with photo-based user identification, automating tracking and reporting.
Developed an admin dashboard for monitoring, report generation and user management.
